rows.label: Railjack
rows.note: needed for the final Earth Proxima fight

rows.label: Mastery Rank 17
rows.note: enforced when Eleanor sells the weapon; unclear if also required to spawn a Coda

conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister of Parvos, or Coda first.

rows.label: Antivirus mods
rows.note: equip 3 at once to test a Duet; tradeable, 3 charges each
rows.alt: buy the stragglers from other players

conditions: Four depleted mods of one type transmute into one fresh charged mod of that type.

Antivirus bounty bug (reported Jan 2026): capture/survival bounties whose objective involves exploding Techrot enemies sometimes fail to complete; Exterminate was reported reliable. Unverified whether this is still live.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even before your own Coda has spawned.

rows.label: spawn via Exterminate, Hell-Scrub or Legacyte Harvest
rows.note: kill Techrot for a Mixtape, hack it; the Coda spawns whether the hack succeeds or not

rows.label: find the correct Antivirus
rows.note: 3 equipped mods tested per Duet Mercy; worst case takes three Duets

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: missions alone cap at 95%; the last 5% must come from a correct-Antivirus Mercy, with Potency mods adding 10-15% each

conditions: Duets spawn at 25% per controlled mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th.
Potency mods do nothing unless the correct Antivirus is also equipped.
Aborting after a successful stab banks the disinfection, but heartcells dropped mid-mission by the Quick Correct mod are lost on abort.
bonuses: Rush order: nuke frame, Exterminates first, then Legacyte Harvest, then Survival; stay ~5 minutes per mission for the Duet's full spawn window.
15% + 15% Potency is the most common loadout once the Antivirus is known.

conditions: Kill DJ RoM first: his Toxin damage bypasses shields and shield gates.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; the frontman regenerates in phases 2 and 4 until his bandmates are dead.
Final-fight bug (reported Aug 2026): a band member can spawn invisible, stalling the frontman's regen loop; unverified, file a support ticket if it happens.
bonuses: Squadmates who each defeat their own Coda in the same Concert add +1 Heartcell, up to +3, whether they Vanquish or Convert.
Revenant's Mesmer Skin, Nyx's Absorb augment, or a recast Dante overguard make you immune to the stage hazards.

disclosures.title: solo is faster
disclosures.body: A solo Concert is faster than a squad one, since every player's Coda gets its own two-part fight back to back; do the disinfection build-up solo and save the squad for the extra heartcell.

groups.meta: Batch A, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Catabolyst is Batch A, alongside Hema, Sporothrix, Pox, Dual Torxica, Mire and Motovore; Batch B carries no Catabolyst.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days at 0:00 UTC.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.
bonuses: Buy it anyway if the roll is 52.8% or higher rather than waiting for 60% — near-unanimous advice, and Valence Fusion can push it to 60% later.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses x1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments are destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs the weapon at rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, or 20 platinum, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
bonuses: Don't fuss about the element — an Elemental Vice lets you pick it later.
